title: One entry of runs/<story>/discovery/decisions.jsonl — bucket ZAPYTAJ (D-2)

hard_list_category.description: D-1 categories. Present ⇒ the decision can never be defaulted; DoD fails without decided_by=owner

context.description: why this matters, for someone who has not read the code

decided_by.description: ONLY a script may write this field, from owner-answers.jsonl
